title: Local Breakfast
excerpt: I’ve been thinking of scheduling a couple of open breakfasts at a local coffee shop between Washington DC and Baltimore – just a chance to meet local leaders and readers who could be free from 8 a.m. to 9:30 or so. If you’re interested, save May 13, and stay tuned for details.…
body: I’ve been thinking of scheduling a couple of open breakfasts at a local coffee shop between Washington DC and Baltimore – just a chance to meet local leaders and readers who could be free from 8 a.m. to 9:30 or so. If you’re interested, save May 13, and stay tuned for details. If there’s some interest, we could do this every quarter or so.
